posts.title: A Late-Night Summer Bike Ride Home
posts.description: The wind has been blowing cold around my neck these past days. I woke up this morning and my voice was raspy. Summer is over. Just a few weeks ago I was paddling down the Isar in an inflatable kayak and getting sunburned. Now I am wearing my winter jacket. A bit of a bummer, I have to say. posts.description: What can I say. It has been a while. Life has been pretty interesting for me, because many things have changed in a short amount of time. There has been a lot of heartbreak.
